label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: After pressing Add to cart the button just became disabled and nothing was announced at that moment; I only learned the mug was added after the cart dialog appeared, and the cart link was not reachable by name as Cart.

element.name: Add to cart Power Surge Mug

findings.problem: The home page has very long repeated lists of press-logo links (the same brand names many times over), so exploring the page by listening is tiring and noisy.

element.name: Learn more about the shop on [name].

findings.problem: The Checkout button in the cart dialog has a hidden icon character in front of its name, so I could not find it by its plain name and had to jump to the checkbox before it and tab forward.
Several New Arrivals items (stir stick sets) and some Best Sellers items have no add to cart button, only a Quick Shop text with no control, so it is unclear how to buy them.
Right after Checkout was pressed the page announced only a banner and empty main region with an empty heading; I had to read again before the form appeared, with no loading message.
